newsitem.title: USA: Iowa unemployment stays at 3 percent in June.
newsitem.headline: Iowa unemployment stays at 3 percent in June.

text.p: Iowa's seasonally adjusted unemployment rate remained unchanged at 3 percent in June and down from the 3.8 percent reported a year ago, the workforce development department reported Thursday.

Seasonally adjusted unemployment rose by 4,500 jobs from May to reach nearly 1.41 million on growth in the services, government, trade and durable goods manufacturing sectors, the department reported.
Nondurable goods manufacturing declined by 900 jobs in June and ran 1,400 below a year ago, in part because of recent layoffs and shutdowns, the department reported.

Employment in the construction sector declined slightly in June, but remained 4,100 jobs ahead of June 1996, the department reported. Nearly 75 percent of the increase has come in 1997, the department added.
Transportation sector and finance sector employment also posted slight declines in June, but are running far ahead of figures from June 1996, the department reported.
